hero.title: Built On Latrobe Pride
hero.subtitle: Established 1981 — competing in the PIHL across Varsity, JV, and Middle School.

intro: The Greater Latrobe Hockey Club (GLHC) is a club sport of the Greater Latrobe Senior High School. The club fields teams in the Pennsylvania Interscholastic Hockey League (PIHL) at three levels: Varsity (grades 9–12), Junior Varsity (grades 9–12), and Middle School (grades 6–8).

teams.name: Varsity
teams.blurb: Holds varsity sport status — letter-earning players are eligible for the school's Letterman's Club.

teams.name: Junior Varsity
teams.blurb: Develops players for varsity-level PIHL competition.

teams.name: Middle School
teams.blurb: The next wave of Wildcats — building skills, conditioning, and game IQ.

history.title: A Dynasty On Ice
history.body: In 2008, 2009, 2010, and 2013, the Varsity Team were the Pennsylvania AA State Champions and Penguins Cup Champions.

governance.title: Governance
governance.body: GLHC is run by an elected board of directors who manage operations and finances on behalf of players, parents, and the school community.
